get.description: A thread's events, oldest first; for a main thread, the project conversation

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: An Agent call's request id: page through that subagent's steps instead of the thread's own conversation

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Latest N events (of those before `before`); on the conversation, every older usage event comes too

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: An event id: only events older than it

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: An event id: every event from it on (up to `before`), to extend a loaded page back to it in one read; limit does not apply

parameters.name: call
parameters.description: A tool call's request id: that call's own events on the conversation (the call, its result, its task events); nothing else applies

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: RFC 3339 time: every event added or changed at or after it (its updated_at), subagent steps included; parent, limit, before and from do not apply
